about: Revert-control kernels for the lite-signal soak (SPEC-B v2 section 1 controls.json, TASK 0a/0b). A control matches a loaded kernel only when BOTH sha256 pins match (kernel.mjs KERNEL_KNOWN_AS -> header.controls.name). A control whose bytes drifted is a MISS, never a skip. Every control is a directory holding Signal.js + Watch.js (Signal.js re-exports ./Watch.js; Watch.js imports ./Signal.js).
